# Tiny C Compiler (TCC)

TCC is a small, fast C compiler that supports ANSI C (C99) and many GNU C extensions.

## Features

- **Small**: Extremely compact C compiler
- **Fast**: Generates machine code directly, compiles ~10x faster than `gcc -O0`
- **Complete**: Full C preprocessor, ANSI C99 support, GNU C extensions
- **C scripting**: Can compile and run C source directly with `-run`
- **Self-hosting**: TCC can compile itself
- **Multi-architecture**: Supports i386, x86_64, ARM, AArch64, RISC-V
- **Dynamic library support**: Any C dynamic library can be used directly
- **Optional bounds checker**: Memory and bounds checking for debugging

## Usage

### Compile a C file to an executable
```
tcc -o output input.c
```

### Compile and run directly (C scripting)
```
tcc -run input.c [arguments...]
```

### Use as a C script interpreter
Add `#!/usr/local/bin/tcc -run` as the first line of your C source.

### Compile to object file only
```
tcc -c -o output.o input.c
```

### Preprocessor options
```
tcc -Idir        # Add include path
tcc -Dsym[=val]  # Define preprocessor symbol
tcc -Usym        # Undefine preprocessor symbol
```

### Linker options
```
tcc -Ldir        # Add library path
tcc -lname       # Link with library
tcc -shared      # Generate shared library
tcc -soname name # Set shared library internal name
tcc -static      # Generate statically linked executable
```

### Warning and debug options
```
tcc -w           # Disable all warnings
tcc -Wall        # Enable common warnings
tcc -Werror      # Treat warnings as errors
tcc -g           # Generate debug information
tcc -b           # Enable bounds checking
tcc -bt N        # Show N callers in bound checker
```

### Other options
```
tcc -v           # Show version
tcc -vv          # Show search paths or loaded files
tcc -bench       # Show compilation statistics
tcc -            # Read source from stdin
```

## License

TCC is distributed under the GNU Lesser General Public License (LGPL).

void tcc_preprocess_file(const char *filename, int is_stdin) {
    BufFile *bf;
    if (is_stdin) bf = tcc_open_stdin();
    else {
        bf = tcc_open_file(filename, 0);
        if (!bf) tcc_error("file '%s' not found", filename);
    }
    pp_out_line = 0;
    pp_cur_file = NULL;
    line_is_open = 0;
    tcc_push_file(bf);
    pp_print_marker(1, bf->filename, 0, 0);
    tcc_push_cmdline();
    for (;;) {
        next();
        if (tok == TOK_EOF) break;
        if (tcc_get_error_count()) break;
    }
    pp_flush_line();
    if (macro_list_mode) print_all_macros();
    fflush(stdout);
}

static void pp_define(void) {
    int i;
    TokenSym *sym;
    Macro *m;
    TokenList params, body;
    int va = 0, nargs = 0, is_func = 0;
    tl_init(&params); tl_init(&body);
    next_raw();
    if (!(tok >= TOK_IDENT)) {
        tcc_error_noabort("invalid macro name '%s'", tok_text);
        skip_rest_of_line();
        return;
    }
    sym = tok_sym;
    if (tok_sym->macro) { /* redefinition: keep the old one */ }
    next_raw();
    if (tok == TOK_EOF) { tcc_error_noabort("invalid macro name '%s'", sym->str); return; }
    if (getenv("TCC_TRACE")) fprintf(stderr, "DEF name=%s tok=%d text=<%s>\n", sym->str, tok, tok_text);
    if (tok == '(' && (!tok_spc || !tok_spc[0])) {
        is_func = 1;
        for (;;) {
            next_raw();
            if (getenv("TCC_TRACE")) fprintf(stderr, "  P tok=%d text=<%s> spc=<%s>\n", tok, tok_text, tok_spc?tok_spc:"");
            if (tok == TOK_EOF) { tcc_error_noabort("invalid macro name '%s'", sym->str); break; }
            if (tok == ')') break;
            if (tok == TOK_DOTDOTDOT) { va = 1; continue; }
            if (tok >= TOK_IDENT) {
                if (params.len < MAX_ARGS) {
                    Token t; save_tok(&t); tl_add(&params, &t);
                }
                nargs++;
            } else if (tok == ',') continue;
            else { tcc_error_noabort("invalid macro name '%s'", tok_text); }
        }
    }
    /* the body: tokens until the end of the line */
    for (;;) {
        if (tok == TOK_EOF) break;
        if (tok_line != pp_directive_line) {
            Token t; save_tok(&t); pushback_tok = t; pushback_valid = 1;
            break;
        }
        {
            Token t; save_tok(&t);
            if (getenv("TCC_TRACE")) fprintf(stderr, "  BODY add tok=%d text=<%s>\n", t.tok, t.text);
            if (body.len == 0) t.spc = NULL;
            tl_add(&body, &t);
        }
        next_raw();
    }

        }
        next();
    }
}

static void pp_ifdef(int want) {
    int val;
    if (getenv("TCC_TRACE")) fprintf(stderr, "PPIFDEF want=%d tok=%d text=<%s>\n", want, tok, tok_text);
    next_raw();
    if (!(tok >= TOK_IDENT)) { tcc_error_noabort("invalid argument for '%s'", want ? "#ifdef" : "#ifndef"); val = 0; }
    else val = tok_sym->macro ? 1 : 0;
    skip_rest_of_line();
    if (cond_n > 0 && cond_stack[cond_n-1].cond == 0) {
        cond_stack[cond_n].cond = 0; cond_stack[cond_n].taken = 1;
        cond_stack[cond_n].in_else = 0; cond_stack[cond_n].dummy = 1;
        cond_n++;
        return;
    }
    if (getenv("TCC_TRACE")) fprintf(stderr, "IFDEF want=%d val0=%d name=<%s> cond_n=%d\n", want, val, tok_sym?tok_sym->str:"?", cond_n);
    if (getenv("TCC_TRACE")) fprintf(stderr, "IFDEF2 want=%d val=%d name=<%s> cond_n=%d\n", want, val, tok_sym?tok_sym->str:"?", cond_n);
    val = (val == want) ? 1 : 0;
    cond_stack[cond_n].cond = val; cond_stack[cond_n].taken = val;
    cond_stack[cond_n].in_else = 0; cond_stack[cond_n].dummy = 0;
    cond_n++;
    if (!val) skip_cond_block();
}
</output>
